L0_unknown.meaning: Unknown or unvalidated category/sub_category. Default to audit/candidate pool.
L0_unknown.frontstage: No display by default; explicit safe labels hook is currently empty.

L1_generic.meaning: Category has only generic-safe display confidence.
L1_generic.frontstage: Generic safe highlights only; issues and category/sub_category labels go to audit/candidate pool.

L2_category.frontstage: High-confidence category-safe labels only; sub_category-specific labels stay in audit/candidate pool.

L3_sub_category.frontstage: Sub_category catalog and verifier display are allowed.
